name: @mexyusef/sidofun-engine
description: Windows-first Bun automation engine for Sidofun

scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun build src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --external playwright-core
scripts.build:ipc: bun run typecheck && bun build src/cli-ipc.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --external playwright-core
scripts.build:operator-cli: bun run typecheck && bun build src/operator-cli.tsx --outdir ./dist --target bun --external playwright-core
scripts.build:operator-cli:help: bun run build:operator-cli && bun run copy:operator-help
scripts.build:operator-daemon: bun run typecheck && bun build src/operator-daemon.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --external playwright-core
scripts.build:mcp: bun run typecheck && bun build src/mcp-stdio.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --external playwright-core
scripts.build:browserext: bun build providers/browser-extension/src/background.ts --outdir ./providers/browser-extension/dist --target browser && bun build providers/browser-extension/src/content-script.ts --outdir ./providers/browser-extension/dist --target browser && bun build providers/browser-extension/src/dom-bridge.ts --outdir ./providers/browser-extension/dist --target browser
scripts.build:release: bun run build && bun run build:ipc && bun run build:operator-cli && bun run build:operator-daemon && bun run build:mcp && bun run build:browserext
scripts.cli:help:refresh: bun run build:operator-cli:help && bun run dist/operator-cli.js --help

author: Yusef Ulum
